config._note_rowRoute: `detailRoute` is inert — the library never reads it. AfspraakDetail is a `type:"custom"` page, so CnPageRenderer's register+schema detail lookup finds nothing and rows do not open without `rowRoute`.

pages.title: Appointment
pages._note: Resolves the appointment, its linked pipelinq Contact and the customer's klantbeeld transaction history in ONE hop through /api/v1/bookings/{id} (BookingDetailController), because the profile card and the history timeline come from a different app across the customer bridge, not from the Appointment object. `type: detail` fetches exactly one OpenRegister object and cannot carry the bridge payload; the timeline additionally needs offset pagination ('Load more') and four distinct fallback states (bridge unavailable, contact unlinked, no history, history hidden) that a declarative field list has no way to render.
